title: Revisiting Ripple Effects in Knowledge Editing through Pressure-Aware Joint Neighborhood Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2606.01610v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Single-edit updates in large language models can trigger ripple effects across local knowledge neighborhoods: desirable propagation to related facts and unintended perturbation of preserved ones. Existing methods address these two effects separately, without explicitly modeling their coupling. We challenge this separation through an analysis of ripple responses across typical baselines, identifying two coupled design pressures: editable-side coordination and preserved-side leakage. We propose Joint Neighborhood Optimization (JNO), a new knowledge-editing framework to formalize and jointly address both pressures at the target-planning stage. JNO instantiates this principle through Pressure-Aware Coordination (PAC), which jointly optimizes neighborhood target representations under coupled constraints, and a semantic pre-execution gate that rejects high-risk target plans before parameter execution. translated_title: 通过压力感知的联合邻域优化重新审视知识编辑中的涟漪效应
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.01610v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：大语言模型中的单次编辑更新可能在局部知识邻域中引发涟漪效应：一方面是向相关事实的理想传播，另一方面是对本应保留事实的意外扰动。现有方法将这两种效应分开处理，没有显式建模它们之间的耦合关系。我们通过分析典型基线方法的涟漪响应表现，对这种分离式处理提出了质疑，并识别出两种相互耦合的设计压力：可编辑侧的协调性与保留侧的泄漏。我们提出了联合邻域优化（JNO），这是一个新的知识编辑框架，用于在目标规划阶段形式化并联合处理这两种压力。JNO 通过压力感知协调（PAC）来实例化这一原则——在耦合约束下联合优化邻域目标表示，并引入语义预执行门控，在参数执行之前拒绝高风险的目标计划。在 RippleEdits 数据集上的实验表明，JNO 实现了（原文截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出联合邻域优化（JNO）框架，通过压力感知协调（PAC）与语义预执行门控，在目标规划阶段联合处理知识编辑中可编辑侧协调与保留侧泄漏这两种耦合压力，从而有效控制编辑引发的涟漪效应。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Joint Neighborhood Optimization (JNO), a knowledge-editing framework that jointly addresses the coupled pressures of editable-side coordination and preserved-side leakage at the target-planning stage through Pressure-Aware Coordination (PAC) and a semantic pre-execution gate, effectively controlling ripple effects in knowledge editing.
